remarks: Welcome to 107 Oakland Place #1, a classically designed, historic co-op residence located on one of Buffalo’s most prestigious and architecturally significant streets. This beautifully maintained first-floor unit offers 2,200 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space that blends timeless elegance with modern comfort. The home features two spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms-including a primary suite-all conveniently located on the first floor. A separate den with a wet bar and a dedicated office, provides flexible space for working from home or relaxing in comfort. There is also a powder room. The formal living room showcases original character details and a WBFP (NRTC,) adding a touch of sophistication for entertaining. The kitchen is a chef’s dream, with granite countertops, a center island, and a walk-in butler's pantry. Appliances include a gas cooktop, built-in oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, and disposal. The formal dining room is perfect for hosting gatherings in style. Additional conveniences include an in-unit first-floor laundry area with no-step access, an ANSI-standard elevator for accessibility, and generous storage throughout. The home also includes a storage room in the basement, a covered porch, and an open-air porch-offering peaceful spots to relax outdoors. Interior features include hardwood floors and beautiful large windows, allowing ample natural light to stream in. This co-op is part of a well-managed, secure building with amenities that include garage parking, a garage door opener, and cable TV availability. The monthly HOA fee of $1,800 includes common area maintenance, common heating and cooling, electric, water and sewer fees, master insurance, trash and snow removal, reserve funding and taxes. Co Op living provides residents with true peace of mind and low-maintenance luxury living, with only 6 units. This is a rare opportunity to own a piece of Buffalo’s architectural history, while enjoying a lifestyle of comfort and convenience. Schedule your private tour today and experience the timeless charm of 107 Oakland Place in the heart of The Elmwood Village-walking distance to many restaurants, shops, and the Medical Corridor.
